visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in a black tank top sitting at a hotpot restaurant table, holding a small bowl and chopsticks. He looks into the bowl and then at the camera with an expressive face. On the table, a hotpot is simmering, and various plates of seafood and vegetables are visible in the foreground. (2) The camera cuts to the man gesturing with his hands while looking off-camera, apparently responding to someone. He maintains a casual, conversational posture. (3) A close-up shot shows the clear broth of the hotpot with corn, mushrooms, and other ingredients boiling inside. (4) The scene shifts to a high-energy shot of the man holding a massive, overflowing platter of seafood, including shrimp, salmon, clams, and abalone, against a backdrop of ice. (5) A close-up of a vegetable platter follows, showcasing neatly arranged mushrooms, greens, carrots, and corn. (6) The man is seen placing leafy greens onto a small digital scale on the restaurant table to measure them, emphasizing a theme of nutritional control. (7) In a more stylized sequence, the man is shown simultaneously eating a piece of meat and performing bicep curls with a small, white dumbbell, looking directly at the camera. (8) He is then seen standing at a self-serve beverage station, filling a metal cup with tea from a dispenser. (9) A woman with glasses is shown at an ice cream machine, dispensing a soft-serve cone. The man enters the frame and makes a 'stop' gesture with his hand. (10) A wide group shot shows four people sitting around the large hotpot table, laughing and enjoying their meal together. (11) Finally, the camera focuses on a 2026 desk calendar featuring cartoon illustrations of people eating at a hotpot restaurant, positioned on a table.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 午餐時間~. (2) [Subtitle]: 哦~好香哦. 吃火鍋好爽喔. (3) [Subtitle]: 你不是在減肥嗎? 減肥可以吃火鍋? (4) [Subtitle]: 到底誰說減肥不能吃火鍋的啊? (5) [Subtitle]: 對啊到底是誰啊? (6) [Subtitle]: 眾所周知呢. (7) [Subtitle]: 飲控也完全可以吃火鍋的好不好. (8) [Subtitle]: 我們今天不私藏大公開. (9) [Subtitle]: 教大家如何減肥正確吃火鍋的方式. (10) [Subtitle]: 你這個湯底呢. 首先就是要挑選我們這種昆布湯底. 低熱量、無負擔. (11) [Subtitle]: 挑好湯底後, 最重要的就是我們今天的食材. (12) [Subtitle]: 是什麼食材啊? (13) [Subtitle]: 就是這盤我最常吃的. (14) [Slogan]: 澎澎海龍王雙人套餐. (15) [Subtitle]: 一盤就有270g的優質蛋白和32g的優質脂肪. 搭配錢都大菜盤. (16) [Subtitle]: 整整一盤蔬菜有深有淺. 重點是0火鍋料. (17) [Subtitle]: 不只營養均衡, 乾淨健康. 還方便計算熱量喔. (18) [Subtitle]: 在我減脂期的這半年間, 我每個禮拜都一定要吃一次火鍋. (19) [Subtitle]: 不管你是要當成練前餐、練後餐, 還是休息日的放縱餐. 錢都火鍋都是你的第一選擇. (20) [Subtitle]: 如果你跟我一樣也在減肥的話, 錢都還有提供無糖茶喝到飽. 好喝、快樂、無負擔. (21) [Subtitle]: 所以吃冰淇淋應該是可以的吧? (22) [Subtitle]: 這個先不要. (23) [Variety]: WWWWWWWWW. (24) [Slogan]: 11月起到錢都火鍋吃火鍋, 加購69元, 就能獲得霸軒與小美的聯名桌曆, 限量售完為止喔. [Logo]: 錢都 CHIEN TU.
